title: Selection of a City Manager Candidate
section: New business (moved to after public comments)
outcome: Approved: Malcolm Hankins recommended as City Manager and negotiations authorized
notes: Commissioners stated choices: Wilson, Cooney, Hoffman and Praedel for Malcolm Hankins; Hess, Decker and Mayor Anderson for Laura Lam.
